subject: Integrated MAP: Sidecar rollout, canary schedule & eval checkpoints
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@borealworks.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@borealworks.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-signature: MAP items and kickoff request

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. BorealWorks is ready to move forward; procurement has the signed order and we'd like to lock down the first-phase implementation details so our engineering and clinical teams can schedule training.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm canary window (we prefer a short 2-day window during low traffic).
- Share the evaluation (acceptance) checklist tied to the MAP.
- Proposed training dates for admin + integrator tracks.

Can you share the MAP you’ll use to run the rollout (milestones, owners, acceptance gates)? If you can get a draft today, we’ll review and book resources.

Thanks —
Samantha Ortiz
Director, Product Ops
BorealWorks

Attachments: none in this message
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@borealworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature: MAP items and kickoff request

Samantha — thanks, and congrats on the sign. I’ve attached a draft MAP (Boreal_MAP_v1.xlsx) that embeds the post-signature implementation plan: rollout phases, canary scheduling, migration steps, training syllabus and the evaluation (acceptance) criteria. High-level summary below.

Planned cadence (phase 1):
- Week 0 (Kickoff): Alignment workshop, roles, and access provisioning.
- Week 1: Canary environment prep + smoke tests.
- Week 2: Canary execution (48-hour window), collect eval metrics and bug triage.
- Week 3: Migration to staged production and integrator training.
- Week 4: Full traffic ramp and hypercare.

Acceptance gates (what we’ll measure):
- Latency SLO: 95p token latency < 300ms for baseline flows.
- Error rate: <0.5% for API errors during canary.
- Quality checks: 10 pre-defined prompt evaluation cases (pass/fail threshold 8/10).

Owners and contacts (draft):
- Redwood rollout lead: Vivek Kulkarni (technical coordination)
- Redwood canary ops: Marissa Cole (canary checklist & monitoring)
- Boreal product lead: Samantha Ortiz (feature acceptance)
- Boreal infra lead: Rajesh Iyer (traffic and network coordination)

I’ve also included a canary checklist (see Marissa’s follow-up) and a week-1 training syllabus (training-syllabus-week1.pdf). Two asks:
1) Can you confirm the preferred canary week (we’ve tentatively penciled July 10–11)?
2) Is procurement ready for a single invoice for phase 1, or do they want separate invoices per milestone?

I’ll sync with Marissa and Laura for the monitoring hooks.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Boreal_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@borealworks.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature: MAP items and kickoff request

Looping in the canary ops checklist (attached as canary-checklist-v2.md). Quick highlights:
- Pre-canary: dataset seeding, feature-flag pathing, KV cache priming.
- Canary day 1: 6-hour smoke window, live metrics dashboard (token-level cost, latency heatmap), priority-1 rollback criteria.
- Canary day 2: extended load, eval set run (10 prompts across 3 personas), finalize pass/fail.

Training owners: I recommend Laura lead the admin training, and Ben Carter run the integrator session (hands-on with SDKs and routing policies). If Boreal agrees, we’ll send calendar invites.

Marissa
Sr. Canary Ops Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachments: canary-checklist-v2.md
From: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@borealworks.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@borealworks.com>
Cc: procurement@borealworks.com
Date: 2028-07-02T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature: MAP items and kickoff request

Vivek / Samantha —
Thanks for the quick turn. July 10–11 for the canary looks OK for engineering, provided we get the final SOW and milestone invoice by EOD July 5. Procurement asked me to confirm:
- Do you need a PO number now or after the canary completes?
- Will Redwood accept a single invoice for phase 1 or separate milestone invoices?

Also, we’ll want read-only access to the monitoring dashboard for our ops team during the canary window. Can you add procurement@borealworks.com to the distribution for the final MAP and SOW?

Thanks,
Rajesh
VP, Infrastructure — BorealWorks
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@borealworks.com>, Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@borealworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@borealworks.com
Date: 2028-07-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature: MAP items and kickoff request

All —

Confirming next steps and commitments (finalizing MAP/SOW timeline):
- July 5 EOD: Redwood delivers final MAP + SOW (we will attach the acceptance checklist and invoices).
- July 10–11: Canary window (48-hour execution) — Redwood ops and Boreal infra on-call.
- July 17: Staged production migration (if canary passes acceptance gates).
- Week of July 22: Integrator + admin training (two half-day sessions).

Procurement answers: we can accept a PO now (recommended) and will produce one consolidated invoice for phase 1; if Boreal prefers milestone invoices we can split by sign-off gates (canary pass / production migration). Please confirm preference and PO number.

Access: Adding procurement and your ops group to the monitoring read-only view — you’ll get an invite from our console tomorrow.

I’ll circulate the final MAP and SOW file by July 5. If any of the timeline items don’t work, please flag by EOD tomorrow so we can adjust before we issue invoices.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth rollout.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0198
Attachments to follow: Boreal_MAP_final.xlsx, SOW_Boreal_Phase1.pdf
